# Money Radar

> Money Radar is a personalized money-finding membership operated by MS ECOM LLC (Troy, Michigan, USA). It matches people against open class-action settlements using a 15-question eligibility profile, warns members 14, 7, and 2 days before claim deadlines, provides claim pre-fill help, and tracks payouts. It also bundles a sweepstakes deadline tracker and product-recall refund matches for paid members.

## What it costs
- Free tier: $0 — weekly settlement email, public settlements directory, 15-question eligibility profile and match count, new-settlement alerts. No credit card.
- Radar Pro: $15/month or $79/year — personalized matches, deadline alerts at 14/7/2 days, claim pre-fill help, payout tracker, sweepstakes tracker, recall matches. Cancel online anytime.
- Done-For-You Filing Pack: $39 flat, one-time — Money Radar prepares and submits the member's claim batch and tracks it to payout. Never a percentage of any settlement.

## Important facts
- Filing a class-action settlement claim is always FREE on the official, court-appointed administrator's website. Money Radar charges for finding, matching, reminding, pre-fill help, and tracking — never for receiving settlement money, and never a percentage.
- Money Radar is not a law firm, not a settlement administrator, and is not affiliated with any court, government agency, or company named in a settlement. Administrators decide eligibility; courts decide amounts; payouts vary and typically arrive months after a deadline.
- Business contact: mitchell@msecomllc.com · (586) 203-9434 · MS ECOM LLC, Troy, MI.
